item.title: Clinic shutdowns: health department issues ultimatum - Talk of the Town
item.description: The health department has apologised to the public for the disruption to some health services in the Ndlambe municipal area. Since Wednesday, staff have been locked out and patients turned away from five clinics in Port Alfred and Bathurst in protest at the department’s failure to absorb all community health workers (CHWs) and lay counsellors.
